# 🛡 Dream-State Emotional UX Impact Assessment

## 📜 Purpose
Before merging, contributors must evaluate how their changes affect the emotional UX contract of Dream-State.

All fields below must be answered thoughtfully.  
Emotional UX is a permanent Codex pillar — **not optional.**

---

## 🧠 PR Author Acknowledgment

- [ ] I have reviewed all API responses affected by this PR for emotional UX tone.
- [ ] I have ensured that validation errors, rate limits, successes, and failures maintain their intended emotional resonance.
- [ ] If any emotional UX changes were made, I have updated:
  - [ ] `/manifest/emotional-ux-scenarios.json`
  - [ ] `/docs/emotional-ux-changelog.md`
  - [ ] Snapshot tests (`/tests/emotional-ux-snapshots.test.ts`) if necessary.

| Field | Your Answer |

## 🛡 Emotional UX Safety Confirmation

By checking these boxes, I confirm:

- [ ] This PR maintains or improves Dream-State emotional UX standards.
- [ ] No user-facing coldness, blame, fear, or mechanical tone was introduced.
- [ ] Any emotional resonance changes are conscious, intentional, and documented.

# 📜 Final Reminder

> Dream-State systems exist not just to **function**, but to **resonate**.  
> Every touchpoint must feel safe, human, and emotionally intelligent — *especially* under failure conditions.

If emotional UX is compromised, this PR **must not** be merged.
